runtime_title: Code With Vibes Orchard Mock Runtime
notice: Every model in this catalog is a pretend course fixture. The orchard namespace is reserved for pretend course fixtures and matches no real repository, vendor, or license. Nothing here downloads weights or runs inference.
learner_sentence: The mock runtime does not think. It proves the operations: pull, serve, bind, measure, stop, restart, recover, swap, promote, and roll back.

orchard-3b-instruct.note: Baseline pretend fixture. The declared size is metadata printed next to the actual payload size; no file of that size is ever created.

orchard-3b-instruct-canary.note: Swap fixture for the config-only swap, comparison, promotion, and rollback drills. It differs from the baseline on a fixed subset of fixture outputs and nothing else. It carries no quant label, no size difference, and no quality claim, so its fixture scores can never appear in a quant comparison result.
